name: Trick or Treat
source:
A 3rd-person visual novel where you play as Kara, a young woman going trick-or-treating on a mysterious street where you have to guess the candy in order to receive it.

Do your best and you might endear yourself to someone enough to have a truly memorable Halloween night!

[From [url=https://turquoiselines.itch.io/trick-or-treat]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一款第三人称视觉小说中，你扮演卡拉，一位年轻女子，在一条神秘的街道上玩“不给糖就捣蛋”游戏，你必须猜出糖果才能收到它。

尽力而为，你可能会赢得某人的喜爱，从而度过一个真正难忘的万圣节之夜！

[来自[url=https://turquoiselines.itch.io/trick-or-treat]itch.io[/url]]
